title: Advanced Geometry & Multi-Operation Orchestration
brief: Handle complex multi-operation programs, rest machining, and advanced geometry patterns. Exhaustive coverage of geometry-related mathematical domains.

units.title: RestMachiningEngine — IPW-aware re-machining with novel algorithms
units.description: Given IPW (in-process workpiece) from previous operation: identify remaining stock regions, decompose into zones, select appropriate novel algorithm for each zone. Uses Minkowski difference for rest material detection. Handles: corner rest (→ smaller tool + SFCR), floor rest (→ CFSF), wall rest (→ PTDC). Multi-tool rest sequencing via DPLS (dynamic programming). Outputs chained operations.

units.title: OperationSequencerEngine — Optimal operation ordering
units.description: Given multiple operations (rough, semi-finish, finish, deburr): find optimal sequence considering: (1) tool change minimization (TSP on tool positions), (2) thermal relaxation time between roughing and finishing, (3) deflection state (rough first for stock removal → finish with PTDC), (4) surface integrity (RSMP requires specific sequence). Uses graph-based optimization with Bellman-Ford for shortest path. Handles fixtures and datums.

units.title: TransitionPathEngine — Optimized linking moves between operations
units.description: Generate optimal retract/approach/linking moves between cut segments and between operations. Algorithms: (1) shortest safe retract (minimum Z clearance), (2) direct linking with collision avoidance (A* on obstacle grid), (3) spiral-in/spiral-out (reduces air time), (4) smooth transitions (G-continuous for surface finish). Integrates with VCER (evacuation retracts) and SFCR (continuous space-filling — minimize retracts).

units.title: AdaptiveRefinementEngine — Error-driven toolpath densification
units.description: After initial novel algorithm computation: refine toolpath where predicted error exceeds tolerance. Uses: (1) curvature-based refinement (insert points where chord error > tol), (2) force-based refinement (PTDC — add points where deflection gradient is steep), (3) thermal refinement (TGAR — densify near thermal zone boundaries), (4) engagement refinement (VCMR — add points where MRR deviates > 10%). Implements adaptive mesh refinement concepts from FEA.

units.title: MultiSetupPlannerEngine — Part orientation + fixturing optimization
units.description: For parts requiring multiple setups: determine optimal orientations, fixture faces, datum transfers. Uses: (1) visibility analysis (which surfaces are accessible per orientation), (2) stability analysis (fixture force equilibrium), (3) datum chain analysis (tolerance stack-up across setups via MCTP Monte Carlo), (4) setup count minimization (set cover problem — NP-hard, greedy approximation). Outputs setup sheets with novel algorithm assignments per setup.
